preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be digits from 0 to 9.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal number of jumps required to reach the last digit from the first digit.
